name: Amane's Inferno
source:
Momose Amane is your average 6th grader! She has friends, just like everyone else, she has a loving mother, just like everyone else, she hates green bell peppers, just like everyone else! Yet despite this fact, she can't seem to find herself content with this life...how strange...

A fanmade MILGRAM PROJECT game about Momose Amane's story and how she may have ended up in MILGRAM!

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/amanes-inferno]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
桃濑天音是六年级的普通学生！她有朋友，就像其他人一样，她有一位慈爱的母亲，就像其他人一样，她讨厌青椒，就像其他人一样！然而尽管如此，她似乎并不满足于这样的生活……真是奇怪……

一款由粉丝制作的MILGRAM PROJECT游戏，讲述Momose Amane的故事以及她如何最终进入MILGRAM！

[来自[url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/amanes-inferno]itch.io[/url]]
